entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello Sarah. I'm calling about an order I received last week. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly help you look into that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-90210-B. The name is Alex Chen.

Thank you, Alex. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Apex Pro cycling shoes, delivered on January 14th. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's definitely a fit and preference issue. I've taken them on two rides, and no matter how I position the cleats or what socks I wear, they're causing painful blisters on my heels.
I'm very sorry to hear that. The right fit is everything, and dealing with blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Okay, good news. I've reviewed your order, and since you received the item just 7 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return period. I can go ahead and authorize a full refund for you.

That's great, a full refund is what I was hoping for. Thank you. Now, since I do have to go through the hassle of packaging these up and I'm still planning to buy a different model from VeloFit, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase? Just to offset the inconvenience.

I understand your position, and I do appreciate you wanting to stick with VeloFit for your next pair. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to issue discount codes for returns related to sizing or preference. However, I can ensure the return is as seamless as possible. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now, so there will be no cost to you to send them back.
Alright, I understand policy is policy. Free return shipping is good, and a prompt refund is the most important thing. I appreciate you checking for me.

Of course. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within two business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that covers it. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
